Package io.webagent4j.extraction.api

package io.webagent4j.extraction.api
Backend-neutral extraction request/result/provenance contracts, converters, validators, and the extraction-specific failure taxonomy - depends only on webagent4j-locator-api, never on webagent4j-dom.

ExtractionRequest is the immutable description of one extraction intent (source locator, raw read type, converter, optional validator), built from its static factories text(...)/attribute(...)/value(...). A converter is always present - these factories start with IValueConverter.identity() - so an engine never has to fall back to an unchecked cast, and a converter that returns null is itself treated as a conversion failure. ExtractionResult can therefore never carry a null value. IValueConverter and IExtractionValidator are the extension points for custom conversion and validation logic.

Not-found and ambiguity are deliberately not part of this package's exception hierarchy - those stay LocatorNotFoundException/AmbiguousLocatorException from the locator layer, never reinterpreted here. See docs/extraction.md for the full read/convert/ validate pipeline, table extraction, and provenance semantics.

    AExtractionException
    Base type for extraction-specific failures.
    ExtractedRow
    One immutable table row's cell text, in DOM column order.
    ExtractedTable
    An immutable, structured reading of one accessible HTML table (table/thead/ tbody/tr/th/td).
    ExtractionAttributeMissingException
    The resolved element exists, but the requested attribute is not present on it - distinct from the source element itself being absent, which is reported by the locator layer instead.
    ExtractionConversionException
    A raw extracted string could not be deterministically converted to the requested target type.
    ExtractionProvenance
    Immutable record of where an ExtractionResult came from, so a caller can understand a surprising value without re-running the extraction.
    ExtractionReadType
    What raw datum an ExtractionRequest reads from a resolved element.
    ExtractionRequest<T>
    Immutable, backend-neutral description of one extraction intent: where to find the source (ExtractionRequest.source(), reusing the existing deterministic locator resolution - no second DOM resolution engine), what raw datum to read from it (ExtractionRequest.readType()), and how to deterministically convert and validate that raw value.
    ExtractionResult<T>
    Immutable outcome of a successful extraction: the converted, validated value; the pre-conversion raw string when this result came from a single scalar read (empty for a list or table result, which aggregate many raw reads rather than carrying one); and where the value came from.
    ExtractionValidationException
    A converted value failed an IExtractionValidator check.
    IExtractionValidator<T>
    Validates one already-converted extraction value.
    IValueConverter<T>
    Deterministically converts one raw extracted string to a target type.
